newsitem.title: USA: Harley-Davidson sells two units for $65 mln.
newsitem.headline: Harley-Davidson sells two units for $65 mln.

text.p: Harley-Davidson Inc said Thursday it completed the sales of its two remaining Transportation Vehicles segment divisions in deals worth a total of $65 million.
The company said it sold the Utilimaster unit to a management-led investor group that included Kirkland Messina, and sold the B&B Molders subsidiary to B&B management.
Harley-Davidson first announced plans to sell the operations in January of 1996 in conjunction with the sale of its Holiday Rambler Recreational Vehicle Division.
Harley-Davidson is the lone American motorcycle manufacturing company.
Its stock closed unchanged Thursday at 44-1/2.
